question: Should OpenClaw core add a first-party per-agent backup/restore/clone command surface now, and what credential/session portability policy should that surface enforce?
rationale: The request is useful but crosses product and security boundaries: it would add public CLI flags, rewrite config and state, and decide whether sensitive credentials and transcripts can move between agents.

options.title: Sponsor core design first
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers define the archive format, credential policy, transcript policy, rollback rules, and relationship to broader backup/restore work before implementation.

options.title: Fold into broader backup work
options.body: Treat per-agent restore/clone as a required subcase of the broader backup/restore roadmap rather than implementing a separate command surface now.

options.title: Defer clone, ship scoped export only
options.body: Allow an initial per-agent backup/export path but postpone restore and `--as` cloning until credential and session migration policy is settled.

recommendation.title: Sponsor core design first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers define the archive format, credential policy, transcript policy, rollback rules, and relationship to broader backup/restore work before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent state, auth, and backup docs history makes this the best available owner for the cross-cutting product/security decision.
